## Activity

During July 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 323 captures. Activity was delivered in line with the planned session arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no other operational issues reported in the information reviewed for this period.

## Image quality

Image quality remained generally acceptable. Graders identified 14 sets as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 4.3. These images could not be used for assessment and should be considered when reviewing the service’s image capture process. The result provides a basis for continued monitoring of image quality and any recurring causes of ungradable images.

## Grading

A total of 88 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 26 days. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image quality to support timely review and appropriate service oversight. Overall, the July 2022 position reflects completed activity at Harbour Eye Clinic, with routine leave noted as the only variation to planned session delivery.
